text.description_html:
Omnia AP-721, Modern Stainless Steel Ladder Pull

Available in 2 lengths: 17-5/16 inches or 33 inches, this Modern Round Stainless Steel Appliance Pull is great for refrigerators. It will bring an extra modern feel to stainless appliances. It has a 25/32 inch diameter. Made from solid stainless steel, it has a brushed stainless steel finish for easy maintenance.

Also Available Modern Round Stainless Steel Door Pull

Specifications of the Modern Stainless Steel Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Available in 2 Sizes:

    721/400:
    • Overall Length: 17-5/16"
    • Center to Center Mount: 15-3/4" (c.c.)
    • Projection: 2-9/16"
    • Pull Diameter: 25/32"
    • Mounting Base Diameter: 1"

    721/800:
    • Overall Length: 33"
    • Center to Center Mount: 31-1/2" (c.c.)
    • Projection: 2-9/16"
    • Pull Diameter: 25/32"
    • Mounting Base Diameter: 1"

Sold Individually
